notes_body: Encoding page Fig 12.2 [#f-lick_matched_panels] (combined figure, 11-17). Columns: cued all licks, cued FIRST post-cue lick, ITI all licks, ITI FIRST lick of a bout, ITI licks made while the spout is DOCKED. Top row: every post-stroke lick (local-linear reference, edge line carried beyond the pre range). Bottom row: only post-stroke licks that landed where the SAME animal's pre curve of the SAME lick set exists, each post curve cut to that range (strict like-for-like). Curves: Gaussian-smoothed per animal x epoch (sigma 0.1 mm; drawn where the Gaussian weight is >= 10 licks), mean +/- SEM over animals; dashed = only three animals. Bars = 0.25-mm landing bins whose change vs pre survives Benjamini-Hochberg (paired nested bootstrap; rows acute / subacute / chronic).

ITI: above pre on the ipsilesional and central side in every epoch and on every ITI set. All ITI -1.9 to +0.4 mm (10/10, 9/15, 10/16 bins; +0.12 to +0.79 mm); first lick of a bout 8/8, 2/12, 10/11; docked 7/8, 2/12, 10/14 (acute -1.6 to +0.1 mm, chronic -1.6 to +0.6 mm). Contralesional landings beyond about +0.6 mm do not differ. Session means, change vs pre (mm; 4/4 unless stated): ITI all +0.35 / +0.24 (3/4) / +0.27; ITI first +0.38 / +0.26 / +0.27; docked +0.29 / +0.22 (3/4) / +0.28. Cued: ipsilesional landings read +0.1 to +0.4 mm contralesional (acute -2.6 to -0.4 mm, 9/15 bins); the furthest contralesional landings read BELOW pre chronically (+1.1 to +1.9 mm, down to -0.30 mm): compression at the edge. Cued all +0.19 / +0.08 (n.s.) / -0.03 (n.s.); cued first +0.36 / +0.22 / +0.16 (4/4 each).

Strict like-for-like (bottom row): 3 % of post-stroke curve points drop out for all licks, 12-19 % for first licks (pre first licks cover a narrower range); no remaining point moves by more than 0.09 mm and the significant bins are identical in every panel and epoch. Dashed stretches: ITI first lick acute, PS95 covers only -1.75 to -0.70 mm (one acute session); ITI docked acute, PS95 has no curve (one session, 53 docked licks).

SIGN: + = READ more contralesional than the lick landed (decoder like-for-like offset, a DIRECTION quantity); landing / decoded lateral position + = contralesional. Decoder: frozen pre-stroke KEY-row lateral lick-position decoder per lick set (z-scored Allen areas with the ALM / tjM1 split, lags 0-0.2 s, August pre sessions, pre scored leave-one-session-out). Offset reference = a Gaussian-weighted local LINE through the animal's PRE licks of the same set (any spout) at the same landing place. Session means; change vs the animal's own pre, 95 % paired nested bootstrap (animals -> sessions). DOCKED ITI = ITI lick onset while the spout is docked (WFIELD_ITI_FILTER=dock), frozen all-ITI decoder, nothing refit. PROVISIONAL (n = 4).
Licks: LP video licks (cam4 detector) with 3-D tongue position from cam1 + cam4 pose; no DAQ spout-contact input.
